name: Bar Drawer
author: sykesthelord
description: A bar button that holds other bar widgets, either in a drop-down shelf or in an inline reveal, so the bar only shows what you pin to it.

barWidget.description: Groups bar widgets behind one button. Click (or hover) opens a shelf under the bar, or slides the widgets out inside the bar. Fill it with omarchy-bar-drawer add <widget-id>.

schema.label: Style
schema.description: dropdown opens a shelf beside the bar; inline slides the widgets out inside the bar itself.

schema.label: Widgets per row
schema.description: Dropdown only. 0 keeps every widget on one row (one column on a vertical bar).

schema.label: Icon
schema.description: Glyph for the button. Leave empty for a chevron that points away from the bar.

schema.label: Label
schema.description: Optional text shown after the icon.

schema.label: Tooltip
schema.description: Leave empty to show how many widgets the drawer holds.
